candidate.answerReason: The bearings place the perpendicular foot between A and B and produce two 45-degree right triangles. Each horizontal leg equals the perpendicular height, so twice that height is 20 nautical miles.

methods.label: Two isosceles right triangles
methods.explanation: Draw \(CD\perp AB\) at \(D\). Then \(\angle CAD=\angle CBD=45^\circ\), \(AD=CD\), and \(BD=CD\). Therefore, \(2CD=20\), so \(CD=10\).
